extDescription.message: Save an entire web page as a single image or PDF

splitNotice.message: The image was split into $COUNT$ parts because of its size. The PDF is still a single file.

errorNotFound.message: The image was not found. Please capture again.

errorComposeFailed.message: Could not assemble the image. Please capture again.

errorTooLarge.message: The image is too large to export.

errorCopyNotAllowed.message: Could not copy. Click this tab, then try again.

errorCopySplit.message: A split image cannot be copied as one. Save the parts individually, or use the PDF.

errorBlockedInternal.message: Chrome's internal pages cannot be captured. Open a regular web page and try again.

errorBlockedWebStore.message: Pages on the Chrome Web Store cannot be captured.

errorBlockedFile.message: Could not capture the local file. Open chrome://extensions, click Details on Utsushi, and check that "Allow access to file URLs" is on. Some files, such as PDFs, cannot be captured even then.

errorCaptureFailed.message: Could not capture the page. Reload it and try again.

errorTabChanged.message: Capture stopped because the tab changed. Keep that tab in front while capturing.

errorQuotaExceeded.message: Captures are happening too quickly. Increase the delay in the settings and try again.

errorPageTooTall.message: This page is too long to capture.

optionsImageFormatHint.message: Used by "Save this part" when the image is split. The PNG and JPEG buttons above always use their own format.

optionsCaptureDelayHint.message: Wait time per screenful. Increase it if the seams are misaligned (500ms minimum applies).

optionsHideFixedHint.message: Hides fixed elements after the first screenful so the same header is not repeated.

optionsPreScroll.message: Scroll through the page once before capturing

optionsPreScrollHint.message: Helps when lazy-loaded images are missing. Capturing takes longer.

optionsFilenameHint.message: Placeholders: {title} page title / {url_host} domain / {yyyyMMdd-HHmmss} capture time

optionsShortcutHint.message: To change it, open chrome://extensions/shortcuts (paste it into the address bar).
